instructions:
Each item is an ontology term that a column of sample metadata in a gene
expression study can mean. Write up to 5 aliases for each term: other ways a
researcher would write that same variable as a column header in sample
metadata.

Good aliases:
- common abbreviations and acronyms ("sbp" for systolic blood pressure)
- shorter everyday phrasings ("systolic bp", "visual acuity")
- the plain name of the quantity when the term's label is wordy
  ("intraocular pressure" for "intraocular pressure measurement")

Rules:
- An alias must mean the same variable as the term: not a broader or narrower
  one, and not a related one.
- No values ("male", "high"), units on their own, gene or tool names, or
  dataset-specific codes.
- No alias that only rewords the label trivially (plural, case,
  punctuation). Those are matched already.
- Fewer is better than wrong. If a term has no natural alias, return an empty
  list.

Examples:
- systolic blood pressure -> ["sbp", "systolic bp", "systolic pressure"]
- intraocular pressure measurement -> ["intraocular pressure", "iop"]
- visual acuity measurement -> ["visual acuity", "va"]

items.label: gestational weight gain measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the amount of weight gained by a woman during pregnancy.

items.label: late gestational weight gain
items.definition: Quantification of the amount of weight gained by a woman during late pregnancy.

items.label: early gestational weight gain
items.definition: Quantification of the amount of weight gained by a woman during early pregnancy.

items.label: single cell nucleic acid sequencing protocol
items.definition: A protocol describing the processes performed and equipment used to determine the order of nucleotide bases in a nucleic acid sample from a single cell specimen

items.label: platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio
items.definition: The ratio of platelet count to lymphocyte count, quantified in a blood sample. Both neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio and platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio have been proposed as biomarkers for the diagnosis or prognostic prediction of disease.

items.label: neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio
items.definition: The ratio of neutrophil count to lymphocyte count, quantified in a blood sample. Both neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio and platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio have been proposed as biomarkers for the diagnosis or prognostic prediction of disease.

items.label: magnesium:creatinine ratio measurement
items.definition: quantification of the ratio of magnesium to creatinine in a sample, typically a urine sample, a proxy measure for Mg2+ homeostasis

items.label: fractional excretion of magnesium measurement
items.definition: quantification of fractional excretion of magnesium based on the calculation of serum and urinary levels of magneiusm and creatinine. Used as a marker of renal tubular function.

items.label: activities of daily living score measurement
items.definition: quantification of ability to perform daily living activities independently. A proxy to assess functional status in the elderly.

items.label: mid-arm muscle circumference measurement
items.definition: quatification of the muscle circumference of the mid arm. A proxy for muscle mass of the arm.

items.label: calf circumference measurement
items.definition: quatification of the muscle circumference of the calf. A proxy for muscle mass of the leg.

items.label: short physical performance battery score measurement
items.definition: quantification of physical performance. A proxy to assess lower extremity function in the elderly.

items.label: sleep apnea measurement during REM sleep
items.definition: A pause in breathing or shallow breaths during REM sleep.

items.label: sleep apnea measurement during non-REM sleep
items.definition: A pause in breathing or shallow breaths during non-REM sleep.

items.label: tacrolimus measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the amount of tacrolimus in a sample.  Tacrolimus (TAC) is a common immunosuppressive agent that potently inhibits T-cell function and proliferation through inhibition of calcineurin by binding to FKB12.

items.label: colorectal health
items.definition: The characteristics of a person’s colorectal health, assessed for example by colonoscopy.

items.label: glucagon measurement
items.definition: The quantification of glucagon, a hormone involved in glucose homeostasis.

items.label: glucose-dependent insulinotropic peptide measurement
items.definition: The quantification of glucose-dependent insulinotropic peptide, an incretin hormone secreted in response to nutrient stimulation that acts to increase insulin secretion.

items.label: glucagon-like peptide-1 measurement
items.definition: The quantification of glucagon-like peptide 1, an incretin hormone secreted in response to nutrient stimulation that acts to increase insulin secretion.

items.label: midregional pro atrial natriuretic peptide measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the levels of midregional pro atrial natriuretic peptide.

items.label: B-type natriuretic peptide to N-terminal pro B-type natriuretic peptide ratio
items.definition: Quantification of the ratio of B-type natriuretic levels to N-terminal pro B-type natriuretic peptide levels.

items.label: dietary potassium intake measurement
items.definition: Quatification of dietary potassium intake by measuring 24 hr urinary potassium levels.

items.label: cardiac stress biomarker measurement
items.definition: A measurement of some protein which is used as a measure of heart failure.

items.label: insulin response measurement
items.definition: Quantification of some aspect of insulin response, typically measuring insulin levels in the blood following a glucose challenge

items.label: lateral ventricle volume measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the volume of the lateral ventricle, the largest cavity of the ventricular system of the human brain which contains cerebrospinal fluid (CSF).

items.label: morphologic finding
items.definition: A light microscopic finding that describes the cellular characteristics and architectural patterns of cell populations in a tissue sample.

items.label: kynurenine measurement
items.definition: Quatification of plasma levels of kynurenine, a ketone that is alanine in which one of the methyl hydrogens is substituted by a 2-aminobenzoyl group.

items.label: kynurenine:tryptophan ratio
items.definition: Quantification of the ration of kynurenine to tryptophan in plasma.

items.label: GLP-1-stimulated insulin response
items.definition: Quantification of insulin release in response to stimulation with GLP-1, typically measured under hyperglycemic clamp.

items.label: tryptophan measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the levels of tryptophan in a sample, typically cerebrospinal fluid or blood

items.label: vitamin D dietary intake measurement
items.definition: Quantification of dietary vitamin D intake.

items.label: complement C3d subcomponent measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the amount of complement C3d subcomponent in a blood sample.

items.label: c3d:C3 ratio
items.definition: Quantification of the ratio of complement C3d to C3 in a blood sample. This measure is a biomarker for systemic complement activation.

items.label: analgesia requirement measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the amount of analgesic drug required during a painful procedure such as surgery.

items.label: free cholesterol measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the amount of free cholesterol in a sample.

items.label: intermediate density lipoprotein measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the amount of intermediate density lipoprotein in a sample.

items.label: dissociation protocol
items.definition: Describes the procedure by which a biological specimen is dissociated into individual cells or a cell suspension

items.label: enrichment protocol
items.definition: Describes the procedure by which the concentration of an entity of interest in a sample is increased.

items.label: age at first birth measurement
items.definition: A measurement of the age at which a woman gave birth to her first live child

items.label: number of children ever born measurement
items.definition: A measurement of the number of children born

items.label: theory of mind measurement
items.definition: Quantification of theory of mind ability, defined as the ability to attribute mental states to one self and others and to use such mental state attribution to make sense of behaviour and predict it. Theory of mind can be quantified using the Emotional Triangles Task test ("Triangles task").

items.label: high altitude adaptation
items.definition: Evolutionary modification in certain human populations who have acquired the ability to survive at extremely high altitudes. This adaptation means irreversible, long-term physiological responses to high-altitude environments, associated with heritable behavioural and genetic changes.

items.label: alcohol exposure measurement
items.definition: Quantification of some aspect of alcohol exposure.

items.label: in utero exposure measurement
items.definition: Quantification of some aspect of the exposure of a fetus to an agent while in the womb.

items.label: tobacco smoke exposure measurement
items.definition: Quantification of some aspect of tobacco smoke exposure.

items.label: vitamin supplement exposure measurement
items.definition: Quantification of some aspect of the consumption of dietry vitamin supplements.

items.label: cholesterol efflux capacity measurement
items.definition: Quantification of cholesterol efflux capacity, a measure of HDL functionality that quantifies the ability of an individual’s HDL to extract cholesterol from cholesterol-loaded macrophages. Efflux capacity is considered to be a predictor of atherosclerotic burden.

items.label: cholesteryl ester transfer protein measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the amount of cholestryl ester transfer protein in a sample, typically serum.

items.label: trimethyllysine measurement
items.definition: Quantification of trimethyllysine (N6,N6,N6-trimethyl-L-lysine) in the blood.

items.label: blood group--lutheran inhibitor

items.label: myopic maculopathy severity measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the severity of myopic maculopathy

items.label: rosacea severity measurement
items.definition: Quantification of the severity of rosacea symptoms, based on a survey of facial, nose and ocular sympoms related to rosacea, a chronic inflammatory skin disease.

items.label: empathy measurement
items.definition: Quantification of some aspect of empathy, i.e. the ability to understand and share another person's experiences and emotions

items.label: heart rate response to exercise
items.definition: Quantification of  heart rate during exercise.

items.label: heart rate response to recovery post exercise
items.definition: Quantification of heart rate during a recovery period following exercise.

items.label: platelet larger cell ratio
items.definition: Indicator of larger (> 12 fL) circulating platelets (percentage).
